purpose: Names the retained non-publication runs the manuscript is allowed to cite, and binds each one to the exact sample bytes it was computed from. A rerun writes a new directory and a new digest, so a paper number can never drift onto evidence nobody reviewed.

Bounded: rung 1 released exactly the corpus footprint (1 Result / 400 Dependency / 6 Outcome facts, scalar 799819/2); rungs 2-3 refused EXPOSURE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED at the reservation estimate, rungs 4-12 refused EXPOSURE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED (evidence span above the Dependency limit) with zero charge. Unlimited: all 12 rungs released their exact corpus footprints (up to 700,000 Dependency facts at 100k rows x 4 columns, client 534 ms). Every charge and scalar matched the frozen corpus rung for rung. 原始目录随 2026-09-19 WSL 重建丢失，由 pilot-footprint-08 重跑替代。

Comparator-arms study, definitive run: the frozen 100-step adaptive trace under four a-priori budgeters (exact three-dimension floors 7/12/18; row counter 175; query counter 70; release-set-only 7) in three frozen orderings. All twelve cells realized the frozen per-step outcome tables exactly (validator pins every accept/refuse, refusal-code family, released rows, and - for the ledger-metering arms - the final-root distinct totals). Headline: the exact floors cap distinct dependency exposure at 12 in every ordering, while the row, query, and release-set-only counters each leak the full 18-fact dependency set in every configuration; the row counter's crossing query is truncated (5 rows to 2 at step 58) rather than refused.

Comparator-arms study, multi-deployment reproducibility run superseding pilot-counter-05: the same frozen 100-step adaptive trace under the four a-priori budgeters in three frozen orderings, now across THREE fresh deployments (repetitions=3, one sample per cell per deployment) for 36 measured samples, three per cell. All twelve cells realized the identical frozen per-step outcome table in every one of the three deployments (zero cross-deployment inconsistency). Headline unchanged and now cross-deployment reproducible: the exact three-dimension floors cap distinct dependency exposure at 12 in every ordering, while the row, query, and release-set-only counters each leak the full 18-fact dependency set in every configuration. Class stays pilot (publication_eligible false): the sealed 172-cell protocol flag is not appropriated for an extension experiment; this is the multi-deployment retained-campaign evidence tier. 原始目录随 2026-09-19 WSL 重建丢失，由 pilot-counter-rigor-03 重跑替代。

Optimizing-adversary study (docs/p9c): two frozen extraction strategies (adaptive threshold bisection; greedy distinct-dependency maximization) against the ten-row expense fixture under three owner-derived budget tiers (budgets from the granted purpose, never from the traces), across THREE fresh deployments (six tier/strategy cells x three samples = 18, zero cross-deployment inconsistency). Every cell realized the frozen a-priori table exactly. Headlines: threshold-probe recovery is cleanly bounded by floor(B_O/2) bits (owner 6, tightened 4; loosened B_O=24 completes all 11 probes and recovers the hidden 1910 exactly) because a probe charges a data-independent 2 novel Outcome facts, so refusals after B_O exhaustion leak no data bits; greedy distinct-dependency extraction is capped exactly at B_D in every order tried (owner/loosened 18 = the granted universe, tightened 12 = B_D). The study also pinned live that aggregate Release identity excludes the predicate literal (same-count same-witness thresholds reuse one Release fact). 原始目录随 2026-09-19 WSL 重建丢失，由 pilot-adversary-05 重跑替代。
